roadmap.title: Hometown: preserve the challenge conditions
roadmap.description: Keep every inlet unrepaired for Craftsman. Before selling leaves in bulk, clear Entrance and Basement and remove 50% of the Pool’s leaves to unlock the value bonuses. Finish the bag throws and leaf-pile jump before disposing of the last leaves. Complete side work before the basement vent.

roadmap.title: Castle: puzzles, cards, and cleanup
roadmap.description: Keep a tied bag for the Library bell and a full upgraded bag for the $10 sale. Complete the puzzles and card checklist before entering the red-carpet throne room.

roadmap.title: Sakura: complete leaf challenges before cleanup
roadmap.description: Use suction mode before the leaves run out. Leave Picnic for the $250 combo and a straight stretch of leaves for the tractor speed challenge. Find all cards, bags, and lanterns before the final story interaction.

roadmap.title: Hometown: focused speedrun
roadmap.description: Replay Hometown with default Custom Mode settings for the under-40-minute run. Repair inlets and skip optional areas; only the route to the secret room is needed.

steps.text: Visit the shed and spend $0.75 on the @item{Medium Leaf Bag}.

achievements.summary: Tie bags containing a total of 5,000 leaves.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Porch} to unlock bag tying, then fill and tie bags until their combined contents reach 5,000 leaves.

achievements.description: Dump a leaf bag while being at least 15 meters away from the trash bin
achievements.summary: Throw a leaf bag into a trash bin from at least 15 meters away.

steps.text: Carry a tied bag across the @loc{Court} to the wall opposite the trash bin. Aim above the bin, then move forward, jump, and release the bag immediately.

achievements.description: Jump into a pile of 1000 leaves
achievements.summary: Jump into a pile containing at least 1,000 leaves.

steps.text: Before clearing the @loc{Pool}, use the @item{Leaf Blower} to push at least 1,000 leaves into one corner. Jump into the pile.
Clear the @loc{Court} to unlock sprinting.
Hold the grey button beside the shed doorway until the garage door is fully open on the monitor. Release it and sprint into the garage before the door closes.
Clear every leaf in the @loc{Basement} to open the shed area.
Clear the @loc{Shed} area, including its roof, then open the wooden gate beside the house.
Finish clearing the @loc{Pool}, then open the large metal gate to the greenhouse area.
Clear @loc{Greenhouse}, then open the vent cover in the @loc{Basement}.

achievements.description: Acquire bag tying, sprint and crouch ability
achievements.summary: Unlock bag tying, sprinting, and crouching.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Porch} for bag tying, the @loc{Court} for sprinting, and @loc{Swings} for crouching.

achievements.description: Hit the basket with a basketball, a beach ball and a leaf bag
achievements.summary: Score basketball-hoop throws with a leaf bag, a basketball, and a beach ball.

steps.text: Bring a basketball from the garage or Court, a beach ball from the @loc{Pool}, and a tied leaf bag to the @loc{Court}. Throw each object through the hoop.

achievements.summary: Collect all eight mysterious photos in Hometown.

collectibles.name: Porch photo
collectibles.location: On the porch railing.
collectibles.method: Pick up the photo from the railing.

collectibles.name: Shed photo
collectibles.location: At the lower corner of the pinboard beside its two posters.
collectibles.method: Take the photo from the board.

collectibles.name: Court photo
collectibles.location: On the rear of the basketball backboard.
collectibles.method: Look behind the backboard and collect the photo.

collectibles.name: Garage photo
collectibles.location: On the floor against the right wall just inside the garage.
collectibles.method: Pick up the photo beside the wall.

collectibles.name: Swings photo
collectibles.location: On top of the electrical box on the house wall.
collectibles.method: From the garage’s back exit, turn left around the house corner and collect the photo.

collectibles.name: Basement photo
collectibles.location: In the middle compartment of the farthest shelf column on your left as you enter.
collectibles.method: Take the photo from the shelving.

collectibles.name: Grill photo
collectibles.location: On the house foundation beside the wooden door.
collectibles.method: After entering the grill area, turn left and look to the right of the door.

collectibles.name: Greenhouse photo
collectibles.location: Inside the scarecrow’s coat.
collectibles.method: Look at the coat lining and collect the photo.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Rake} and @item{Leaf Blower} in the shed, then use the Upgrades menu to finish every hand, rake, and blower upgrade.
Finish clearing every Hometown area. Press @mechanic{V} to highlight leaves belonging to your current area when searching for stragglers.

achievements.description: Earn an immense number of shekleaves ($700)

guide.context: This counts earnings, so you can spend money on upgrades. Selling too many leaves before the value bonuses can leave this run short of $700.

steps.text: Buy the Medium Leaf Bag and early hand upgrades, then clear @loc{Entrance} before selling your first stockpile of tied bags.
Use those earnings to buy the Large Leaf Bag. Stockpile further tied bags until the @loc{Basement} is clear and the @loc{Pool} is 50% clear.
Once all three leaf-value bonuses are active, sell the stored bags and finish collecting the map’s remaining leaves.

achievements.description: Complete the Hometown in under 40 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish Hometown in less than 40 minutes.

guide.context: Pause the game whenever you need to review the route; pausing also stops the timer. This run repairs inlets, so finish Craftsman first.

steps.text: Start a fresh Hometown run with default Custom Mode settings. Enable the game timer in Settings.
Repair the free inlet beside the porch stairs. Clear @loc{Porch}, prioritizing Greedy Grasp and Dexterity upgrades, and buy the Medium Leaf Bag for $0.75.

Clear @loc{Driveway} for its movement-speed bonus. Buy the Large Leaf Bag for $3.49. From the shed doorway, hold the garage button until the monitor shows the door fully open, then take the shortest route into the garage.
Clear @loc{Basement}, then @loc{Shed}. Max Greedy Grasp and Dexterity. Buy the Rake for $7.49 and keep $15 for the Pool inlet.
Repair the @loc{Pool} inlet. Rake leaves into the pool and toward the inlet while improving Sweep Radius, Leaf Stickness, and Handle Length.
Clear @loc{Swings} with the rake and its $6 inlet, then clear @loc{Greenhouse} using its $25 inlet. Buy the Leaf Blower if affordable and push the greenhouse’s inside leaves outdoors to the inlet.
Open the basement vent and crouch to the secret room before the timer reaches 40:00. Skip the optional Entrance, Front Yard, Court, Garage, Grill, and Maze cleaning.

achievements.description: Complete the Hometown without repairing any leaf inlets
achievements.summary: Finish Hometown without repairing a leaf inlet.

guide.context: Repairing even the free inlet beside the porch invalidates this run. Complete this challenge before the separate speedrun.

steps.text: Leave every leaf inlet unrepaired throughout Hometown; bag the leaves and use trash bins instead.
After clearing Greenhouse and Swings, open the basement vent and crouch through to the secret room.

achievements.description: Complete all objectives in the Hometown

guide.context: Missed photos can be recovered by selecting Hometown in Load Game. Reloading a finished map does not restore discarded leaves.

steps.text: Finish Hometown’s cleaning, upgrades, and photo collection before entering the basement vent. Check the journal for any remaining objectives, then crouch through the vent to the secret room.

guide.context: For a missed card or puzzle, use Load Game and select the Castle map box above the save date. This preserves the cleared map rather than respawning leaves.

steps.text: Finish Castle’s journal objectives, including the remaining cleaning and card collection, before entering the red-carpet throne room. Open the throne-room door after completing the remaining tasks.

achievements.description: Clean up all leaves in castle

steps.text: Clear every Castle area, using @mechanic{V} to find the last leaves belonging to each area.

achievements.description: Hit a bell with a leaf bag and make it ring
achievements.summary: Ring a bell by hitting it with a leaf bag.

steps.text: Carry a tied leaf bag into the @loc{Library} tower. From atop the bookshelf, hurl the bag into the bell so the bell swings and rings.

achievements.description: Score exactly 67 points at the shooting range
achievements.summary: Finish a shooting-range test with exactly 67 points.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Armory}, then take the crossbow upstairs from the courtyard.
At the crossbow range, score five hits worth 10 points, four worth 3 points, and one worth 5 points. Aim for the yellow, blue, and red scoring circles respectively.

guide.context: Clear Library to unlock mosaic assembly.

collectibles.name: Hallway mosaic
collectibles.location: In the Hallway.
collectibles.method: Fit the loose pieces into the window to complete the picture.

collectibles.name: Library mosaic
collectibles.location: On the Library tower.
collectibles.method: Fit the loose pieces into the window to complete the picture.

collectibles.name: Leaf Garden mosaic
collectibles.location: In Leaf Garden.
collectibles.method: Fit the loose pieces into the window to complete the picture.

achievements.description: Destroy a mosaic and then assemble it again
achievements.summary: Break a completed mosaic and rebuild that mosaic.

steps.text: Throw a tied leaf bag or a book at a finished mosaic. Replace every piece knocked out of the window.
Clear the @loc{Dinette}, then play its memory game. Reveal cards in pairs and match every pair.

achievements.summary: Pass the crossbow test with at least 70 points.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Armory}, then take the crossbow upstairs from the courtyard.
Shoot the targets until the test ends with at least 70 points.
Clear the @loc{Labyrinth}, then use the sliding puzzle there.
Put tiles 1–4 across the top row, then 5–8 across the second row. Finish the lower two rows in pairs of columns: 9 above 13, 10 above 14, and 11 above 15. Leave 12 above the empty final space.

achievements.summary: Sort all flower petals into their matching colors.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Hallway}, then use the petal-sorting table. Place each petal in the bowl matching its color.
Clear the @loc{Gate} area.
Clear the @loc{Fresco} area.
Clear the @loc{Stairs} area.
Clear the @loc{Terrace}.
Clear both @loc{Love Garden} and @loc{Leaf Garden}, then use their Key Fragments to unlock the throne room.

achievements.summary: Sell one Castle leaf bag for $10.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Fresco}, @loc{Terrace}, and @loc{Shooting Range} for all three leaf-value bonuses. Keep some leaves uncollected for the final bag.
In the shop beneath Dinette, buy the Large Leaf Bag for $7.49 and then the @item{Giant Leaf Bag} for $14.99 from the wall beside the skull. Max out Hand’s Bag Capacity upgrades.
Fill the upgraded bag completely and throw the tied bag into a trash bin.

achievements.summary: Collect all eight Castle playing cards.

collectibles.location: Under a shelf lip in the narrow bookcase between the blower and bag displays.
collectibles.method: Look up at the shelf’s underside and take the card.

collectibles.name: Fresco card
collectibles.location: On the shield held by a squirrel statue beside the arched passage.
collectibles.method: Check the face of the shield.

collectibles.name: Dinette card
collectibles.location: Low on the wall beside the wooden exit toward Stairs.
collectibles.method: Look beside the doorway at floor level.

collectibles.name: Ruins card
collectibles.location: On a battlement visible through the arch from Dinette.
collectibles.method: Look past the stacked barrels and take the card from the stone merlon.

collectibles.name: Terrace card
collectibles.location: Against a square battlement on the outer parapet.
collectibles.method: Check the wall between the raised stone merlons.

collectibles.name: Love Garden card
collectibles.location: High on a timber support under the vine-covered pergola.
collectibles.method: Look up at the beam and collect the card.

collectibles.name: Leaf Garden card
collectibles.location: On a column ledge beside an interior arch, near the bench with flowerpots.
collectibles.method: Take the card above the column’s capital.

collectibles.name: Throne Room threshold card
collectibles.location: At floor level against the right side of the arched doorway behind the Labyrinth.
collectibles.method: Check the foot of the right-hand column.

achievements.description: Put all books on the bookshelf
achievements.summary: Return all six Library books to the bookshelf.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Library} tower after unlocking Dinette. Pick up the six scattered books and place each on the bookshelf.

guide.context: Missed cards and activities can be recovered with the Sakura map box in Load Game. The completed map’s leaves remain cleared.

steps.text: Check the journal and finish Sakura’s remaining objectives, including its leaves, battle cards, preplaced bags, and hanging lanterns. Open the Ancient Tree gate after completing the remaining tasks.

achievements.description: Clean up all leaves in Sakura

steps.text: Finish clearing all Sakura areas after completing the suction, $250 combo, and tractor speed challenges. Use @mechanic{V} to find each area’s remaining leaves.

achievements.summary: Earn $250 in one uninterrupted collection combo.

steps.text: Before clearing @loc{Picnic}, blow its leaves into a large pile.
Drive the mini tractor through the pile and nearby leaves without stopping or colliding with obstacles. Keep collecting until the current earnings counter reaches +$250.
After clearing Playground or Garden, buy the @item{Mini Tractor} in the park.

achievements.description: Collect leaves when driving at no less than 6 m/s
achievements.summary: Collect leaves with the mini tractor while traveling at least 6 m/s.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Sport Mode} and max out @mechanic{Chiptuning}. Leave some leaves at the end of a clear, straight route.
Accelerate in Sport Mode. As you reach the leaves, switch back to collection mode while still moving at least 6 m/s.

achievements.description: Dispose of leaf bags spread across the park
achievements.summary: Dispose of all 12 preplaced leaf bags in Sakura.

collectibles.method: Look inside the tunnel and collect the card.

steps.text: Use the Upgrades menu to max out the mini tractor’s upgrades. Buy @mechanic{Sport Mode} and its Chiptuning upgrades as well for the speed challenge.

achievements.description: Make all pinwheels spin at once
achievements.summary: Have every Statues-area pinwheel spinning at the same time.

steps.text: Sweep the @item{Leaf Blower} across all the pinwheels in @loc{Statues}. Keep blowing across the group until every pinwheel is turning together.

achievements.description: Suck up 10,000 leaves with a leaf blower
achievements.summary: Collect 10,000 leaves using the leaf blower’s suction mode.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Suction Mode} in the Upgrades menu, then use the blower’s suction function to collect 10,000 leaves.
Clear the @loc{Statues} area.
Clear the @loc{Temple}.
Clear the @loc{Temple}.
Clear either @loc{Playground} or @loc{Garden}.
Clear @loc{Open-air}.
Clear @loc{Dog Run}, then pay $500 to open the Ancient Tree gate.
At the @loc{Ancient Tree}, collect the final story pickup beside the trunk to end the campaign.
